exp.desc:
- Toddler room, 12 children aged 1–3
- Settling-in and parent updates
- Observations and learning journals

cl.p1: During my final placement I worked in a room of twelve children aged one to three, and the settling-in period fascinated me most: how differently children and parents experience those first weeks.
cl.p2: I led three settling-in periods myself, with a first meeting, daily updates for parents and a review at the end. One little boy cried every time his mum left; we shortened the separations and made his cuddly toy part of the routine, and after four weeks he ran to me in the morning.
cl.p3: I hold a current paediatric first aid certificate and my background check is complete. I can start in August.

cl.p1: For seven years I have worked with school-age children in an after-school club, and I know all fifty of them by name – and by their favourite excuses at homework time. I am moving and looking for a new role with school-age children.
cl.p2: I introduced a children’s council that decides on outings, rules and how we use our rooms. Arguments over football dropped noticeably once the children had made the rules themselves. I have also completed advanced safeguarding training.
cl.p3: My notice period is six weeks. I would welcome the chance to visit.
